suggested_change: Separate 'evidence quality' penalties from 'call advancement' penalties. Remove ICP validation as a first-call failure criterion. Replace 'seller-generated analysis' penalty with 'prospect articulation required' only for later-stage deals. Clarify baseline carry-forward rule: either require explicit documentation OR accept score variance on first call. Remove timeline 'realism speculation' requirement; accept stated timelines unless contradicted by prospect language.
